name: AykoShop AI CRM - Scoring
description: يحسب AI Lead Score + Sentiment لكل زبون كل ساعة

parameters.query: SELECT p.subscriber_id, p.customer_name, p.channel, p.stage, p.interested_in, p.total_messages, string_agg(h.message, ' | ' ORDER BY h.created_at DESC) as recent_messages FROM aykoshop_profiles p LEFT JOIN aykoshop_chat_history h ON h.subscriber_id = p.subscriber_id AND h.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' WHERE p.last_seen > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY p.subscriber_id, p.customer_name, p.channel, p.stage, p.interested_in, p.total_messages LIMIT 50
